ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: We use the camera when you photograph your plate, to estimate the meal’s protein, or a lab report, to read its results.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We open your photos so you can choose a picture of a meal, a lab report or your profile photo.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to show how far the clinics in our partner network are. It stays on your device and isn’t sent to anyone.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: We read your weigh-ins from Apple Health to complete your progress curve without you typing them in. They join your journal like the ones you log — we keep them in your account, and if you connect to a clinic, its team sees them too.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We use the microphone when you tap to dictate a question instead of typing it.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: We turn your speech into text in the question field. You read what came out before sending it.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: We don’t write anything to Apple Health — we only read your weigh-ins.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: We don’t use your device’s motion sensors.
